title: LG watch not working with xdrip since wear OS update
body:
The latest Wear OS update has broken the X Drip watch face. On the watch, the xdrip readings often lag, show missed readings when in fact the reading is not missed and at times the watch face appears disconnected from app. I am running the latest nightly on my Pixel 2 which has been consistently performing at 100 % capture rate.
Please note that prior to the wear OS update all was working just fine.
The update is : Wear OS 2.1 ( Sep 28, 2018)
xDrip+ version = Oct 15th nightly
LG watch = LG Watch Sport Unlocked GSM

comments.body:
Screen Print showing disparity in missed readings.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17143130/47257590-8694af80-d455-11e8-8e69-44624d17171f.png)

I have resolved this issue by performing the following steps:
1) Factory reset the LG Sport watch.
2) Update the watch to the current Wear OS release( Oct 2018 ).
3) Install the latest xdrip+ nightly ( Oct 15th 2018) on my Pixel 2 XL.
4) Install the xdrip+ watch face on the my LG sport watch ( google play.. apps on my phone )
5) Watch face works without issues.
